evidence.quoted_text:
"manager_restarted": (
            (((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
             .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                 .get("pid") or 0) > 0
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("pid")
            and bool(((manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and bool(((manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager") or {})
                     .get("invocation_id"))
            and (manager.get("before") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")
            != (manager.get("after") or {}).get("manager", {}).get("invocation_id")),
evidence.reason: The `manager_restarted` check only requires nonempty, differing manager PIDs and invocation IDs. If the guest reboots between the before and after snapshots, those same fields can differ and the check passes even though the observations span a reboot rather than proving an isolated manager restart. Adding nonempty, equal `boot_id` values from both manager snapshots, while retaining the PID and invocation-ID checks, fixes this existing correctness gap. This is a routine evidence-correctness repair, not a new product requirement or owner decision.
